title: customer-success
text:
customer-success

nora_csm: Heads-up — we need to run a 4-week interactive skillshare series for the Meridian POC customers next month. Goal: ramp their engineers on routing policies, dedicated capacity basics, and a short hands-on lab. Need volunteers for session leads and a proposed schedule.
kevin_cs_ops: I can lead a session on rollout policies. available Tues/Thu mornings PT. :rocket:
sarah_enablement: I’ll cover onboarding playbook + preflight checklist. can do afternoons PT. also recommend a 30m pre-read video we can share.
joel_engineering: happy to run the hands-on lab (deploy -> smoke test -> perf checks). prefer Wed midday PT. need 2x GPUs reserved for the demo.
nora_csm: good, rough agenda idea below — please react with :thumbsup: to confirm or suggest edits.
--- agenda ---
1) 10m intro + goals
2) 20m onboarding playbook (sarah)
3) 30m rollout policies & routing (kevin)
4) 40m hands-on lab (joel)
5) 20m Q&A + feedback capture
----------------
kevin_cs_ops: looks solid. can we trim lab to 30m and add a short troubleshooting walkthrough? customers love that.
sarah_enablement: yes trim to 30m, leave 10m for troubleshooting. also suggest we ask customers to bring one failing prompt or latency trace.
joel_engineering: fine — I’ll prebuild the lab notebook and a small synthetic dataset. can someone reserve the Dedicated pool for demo slots? cc @enablement-bot
enablement-bot: calendar: provisional slot created for Wed 2026-04-08 12:00 PT (skillshare — Meridian POC). Invite sent to hosts.
kevin_cs_ops: timezone callout — we have APAC participants; can we run alternate slot 1 week later at 02:00 UTC/11:00 AET?
sarah_enablement: yes, we should run at least one APAC-friendly session. i’ll add a registration form and ask folks to pick preferred timezone. link: https://forms.gle/example-signup
nora_csm: action items: (1) sarah: publish pre-read + form by end of week, (2) joel: lab notebook + infra checklist, (3) kevin: troubleshooting slides + short checklist, (4) ops: confirm Dedicated pool reservation. please add estimated prep time next to your name.
kevin_cs_ops: prep ~3h.
sarah_enablement: prep ~4h, will record the pre-read.
joel_engineering: prep ~5h incl infra.
kevin_cs_ops: also tagging renewal risk — Meridian engineering team mentioned SLA questions in last call. can we add a 5m moment to surface contract/SLA links?
sarah_enablement: good call. add 5m near the intro to outline support tiers + where to raise capacity requests.
nora_csm: ✅ added. also we need a feedback capture plan: short in-session poll + 3-question post-session form. who can draft the poll?
kevin_cs_ops: I’ll draft the in-session poll (3 quick Qs).
ora_csm: perfect. final ask — try to keep slides under 20 and include 1 troubleshooting playbook PNG for quick reference.
enablement-bot: reminder scheduled: Prepare slides & lab materials (hosts) — due 2470008000.
sarah_enablement: shared folder created: drive.redwood.com/meridian-skillshare — will populate pre-read and slides by Fri.
joel_engineering: added lab notebook and infra commands snippet to the folder. sample command: `rwd serve --model redwood-1 --dedicated-pool meridian-demo --batch 8`
kevin_cs_ops: joined. i’ll post the in-session poll draft here tomorrow.
nora_csm: thanks team. small follow-up: who will take attendee success follow-ups and capture renewal signals after sessions?
sarah_enablement: i can own immediate follow-ups for 48h. then pass any renewal risk flags to account team.
kevin_cs_ops: ok i’ll monitor the poll and escalate any SLA/latency concerns.
ora_csm: great. closing thread — i’ll convert to a calendar series once APAC slot confirmed. :calendar:
